headings.title: Labeling required on installed safety glazing
headings.reviewNote: Mandatory visible and legible label identifying the labeler and safety glazing status on installations in hazardous locations

headings.title: Prohibition on labeling nonconforming glazing
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits using safety glazing label designations on non-safety materials

headings.title: Unlawful sale of nonconforming doors or enclosures
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits selling or offering to sell sliding glass doors, storm doors, shower doors, and entrance doors not made of safety glazing

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.015 requires visible identification labels on safety glazing installed in hazardous locations, prohibits labeling noncompliant glass, and bans sales of nonconforming doors and enclosures.

headings.title: Powers and duties of the department
headings.reviewNote: Grants power to promulgate rules, investigate complaints, inspect property upon probable cause, authorize innovative trials, and offer technical assistance

headings.title: Rulemaking authority and procedural requirements
headings.reviewNote: Conditions validity and effectiveness of on-site sewage rules on compliance with section 536.024

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsections for 701.033 outlining department powers and duties for on-site sewage disposal and section 536.024 rulemaking compliance (cross-referenced to nonseverability clause § 640.099).

headings.title: Notice of violation and required content
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice specifying reasons, reasonable time, proper service, and remedial action outline upon reasonable grounds of violation

headings.title: Restrictions on inspecting existing systems
headings.reviewNote: Bars inspection of existing systems absent reasonable grounds of violation

headings.title: Administrative hearings and judicial review
headings.reviewNote: Establishes ten-day hearing request timeline, twenty-day hearing window, thirty-day decision limit, and administrative or de novo judicial appeals

headings.title: Abatement timelines, extensions, and daily penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes cities, counties, or the department to require abatement within thirty days (extendable to sixty days for weather or contractor unavailability with approval) and authorizes administrative penalties up to fifty dollars per day.

headings.title: Enforcement proceedings by prosecuting attorney
headings.reviewNote: Directs county prosecuting attorney to institute correction proceedings upon request of city, county, or department

headings.title: Emergency injunctions and dissolution of orders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department to seek temporary restraining orders and injunctions for imminent health hazard emergencies and request dissolution upon correction

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.037 establishes the notice and hearing process for sewage disposal violations, timelines and penalties for nuisance abatement, prosecution procedures, and emergency injunctive relief.

headings.title: Complaint investigation conditions and adjoining property access
headings.reviewNote: Restricts complaint investigations to communicable disease cases or complaints from aggrieved parties or adjacent landowners, and regulates entry on adjoining property

headings.title: Compliance with standards upon finding nuisance
headings.reviewNote: Mandates compliance with state and local standards when repairing or replacing a system found to be a nuisance

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.038 governs department investigations of sewage complaints from aggrieved parties or adjacent owners, entry on adjoining property, and standard compliance for nuisance repair.

headings.title: Scope and content of state standards
headings.reviewNote: Defines elements of state standard including site selection, design specs, permits, inspections, repairs, engineering for slow percolation, and variances

headings.title: Prohibition against additional local requirements
headings.reviewNote: Bars cities, counties, or the department from imposing additional requirements once state standards are met

headings.title: Mandatory inspection quotas for sewage systems
headings.reviewNote: Requires aggregate inspection of up to sixty percent of registered contractor installations and at least seventy-five percent of unregistered installations

headings.title: Certification acceptance from registered contractors
headings.reviewNote: Allows acceptance of compliance certification without on-site inspection from registered contractors not required to provide a performance bond under section 701.052.

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.043 sets forth components of state on-site sewage standards, restricts additional local requirements upon compliance, specifies inspection quotas, and permits contractor certification in lieu of inspection.

headings.title: Deposit of fees in public health services fund
headings.reviewNote: Directs department sewage collections, excluding penalties, into public health services fund for program implementation and local contracting

headings.title: Appropriations for innovative systems and pilot programs
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director, upon appropriations from the general assembly, to use Missouri public health services fund moneys for innovative sewage systems and pilot programs.

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.049 directs sewage fee deposits into the Missouri public health services fund for program administration and permits funding for innovative pilot projects.

headings.title: Bond or letter of credit required after conviction
headings.reviewNote: Bars persons convicted of sewage violations within twenty-four months from working on others' systems without financial assurance

headings.title: Bond conditions and required amount
headings.reviewNote: Requires five-thousand-dollar bond or letter conditioned on faithful compliance with state sewage standards

headings.title: Permitted forms of financial assurance
headings.reviewNote: Specifies acceptable forms as surety bonds or irrevocable letters of credit from authorized institutions

headings.title: Notice of noncompliance and bond forfeiture
headings.reviewNote: Mandates thirty-day notice to cure noncompliance before forfeiture of bond funds into public health services fund

headings.title: Expenditure of forfeited funds for registered contractors
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to expend forfeited funds within thirty days to hire registered contractors to achieve compliance

headings.title: Cessation of bonding requirement after two years
headings.reviewNote: Terminates bonding requirement after two consecutive violation-free years

headings.title: Emergency repair exception and expedited review
headings.reviewNote: Allows emergency major modification or repair to relieve an imminent health hazard without a permit, requiring notice by the fifth working day and an expedited review process.

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.052 establishes bonding requirements for contractors with prior sewage violations, specifies forfeiture and repair procedures, sets the expiration term, and governs emergency repairs.

headings.title: Contractor registration and statewide validity
headings.reviewNote: Restricts registered contractor representation to registrants and provides that county registrations carry statewide validity

headings.title: Educational training program qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Requires successful completion of department or certified county training program for contractor registration

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.053 governs the registration and statewide recognition of on-site sewage contractors, conditioning qualification on successful completion of an approved training program.

headings.title: Revocation, suspension, and appeals of registration
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes registration denial, suspension, or revocation, thirty-day departmental appeal, judicial review under chapter 536, and one-year reapplication bar

headings.title: Requirement to furnish proof of valid registration
headings.reviewNote: Requires contractors to present proof of registration upon request by any person, municipality, county, or department

headings.title: Publication of official rosters and disciplinary lists
headings.reviewNote: Mandates publication of official roster of registered contractors and public list of disciplinary actions

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.054 outlines the grounds and appellate procedure for denying, suspending, or revoking contractor registrations, mandates proof of registration, and directs publication of rosters.

headings.title: Property owner installation and repair rights
headings.reviewNote: Preserves right of property owners to install, modify, or repair their own systems in compliance with state standards

headings.title: Exemption from cleaning permit and contractor registration
headings.reviewNote: Exempts property owners from permit and contractor registration requirements when cleaning their own systems

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.055 allows property owners to construct or repair their own on-site sewage systems in compliance with state standards and exempts system cleaning from permits and registration.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor violations
headings.reviewNote: Designates violations of sections 701.052 through 701.055 as class A misdemeanors

headings.title: Class C misdemeanor violations
headings.reviewNote: Designates violations of section 701.046, 701.047, 701.048, or 701.050 as class C misdemeanors.

headings.title: Infractions and enhanced persistent violations
headings.reviewNote: Designates violations of sections 701.029 and 701.031 as infractions, elevating persistent violations to class C misdemeanors

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.057 classifies criminal penalties for violations of on-site sewage laws into class A misdemeanors, class C misdemeanors, and infractions with enhancements for persistent violations.

headings.title: Nuisance infraction on large residential parcels
headings.reviewNote: Classifies creation of a nuisance or imminent health hazard on single-family lots of three acres or more as an infraction

headings.title: Accrual of statute of limitations for defective systems
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that for purposes of section 516.120, the statute of limitations begins to run when an owner knows or should have known a contractor installed a defective, inappropriate, or incorrect system.

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.059 makes creating a sewage nuisance on residential lots of three or more acres an infraction and specifies when the statute of limitations accrues against contractors.

headings.title: Lead hazard inspection conditions and entry orders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes lead hazard inspections upon notification of elevated blood lead levels, requiring credentials, consent, or forty-eight-hour court order

headings.title: Authority to take laboratory samples
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes removal of environmental samples for laboratory analysis to detect lead hazards

headings.title: License and accreditation fees and penalty deposits
headings.reviewNote: Directs assessment of licensing and accreditation fees and deposit of fees and penalties into public health services fund

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.304 specifies preconditions for inspecting lead hazards in dwellings and child-occupied facilities, authorizes court entry orders and sampling, and establishes fee and penalty deposits.

headings.title: Owner duty to abate lead hazard or remove rental
headings.reviewNote: Requires owner compliance with abatement or interim controls following lead hazard notice, or withdrawal of unit from rental market

headings.title: Tenant protection against discriminatory eviction
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits evicting tenants due to elevated blood lead levels, suspected lead poisoning, or required remediation actions

headings.title: Childcare attendance protection for exposed children
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits denying facility attendance to children due to elevated blood lead levels or remediation actions

headings.title: Reentry inspection authority and court orders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes reinspection to verify abatement effectiveness, providing for court entry orders upon forty-eight hours notice

headings.title: Violation findings upon reentry and compliance orders
headings.reviewNote: Deems an owner in violation upon failed reentry inspection (without itself creating a cause of action) and directs written notice and cease-and-abate compliance orders.

headings.title: Relocation assistance and injunctive enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes tenant relocation assistance through local officials and injunctive enforcement by county prosecuting attorneys

headings.title: Commercial lead production area requirements and exemptions
headings.reviewNote: Governs abatement in commercial lead production areas and exempts compliant residential owners from industrial remediation liability

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.308 mandates owner abatement of lead hazards, prohibits evicting affected tenants or excluding children, establishes reinspection procedures, and provides commercial lead area rules.

headings.title: Lead abatement project notification and fee
headings.reviewNote: Requires lead abatement contractors to submit written notice and twenty-five-dollar fee at least ten days prior to project start

headings.title: Duty to inform owners and tenants of website resources
headings.reviewNote: Directs contractors and funding entities to inform owners and tenants of department internet lead hazard resources

headings.title: Penalties and escalating fines for failing to notify
headings.reviewNote: Imposes escalating fines starting at two hundred fifty dollars and doubling for repeated failures to give project notice

headings.title: Written notification content and hazard disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Requires pre-project written notice to include disclosure of potential lead hazards from initial risk assessment

headings.title: Emergency notification procedures and late filing
headings.reviewNote: Permits twenty-four-hour informal notice and five-day written submission during emergency lead abatement situations

headings.title: Post-abatement clearance report filing
headings.reviewNote: Requires contractors to submit written notice and final clearance results report upon project completion

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.309 governs mandatory pre-project notice and fees for lead abatement contractors, escalating failure-to-notify fines, emergency procedures, and post-abatement reporting.

headings.title: Safe performance standards for lead abatement
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that lead abatement be performed without endangering occupants or workers

headings.title: Owner self-abatement exception and consultation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes qualifying owners, partners, or corporate officers to personally perform lead abatement in their own dwelling if not occupied by non-family persons and no resident child has an elevated blood lead level, after prior department consultation.

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.310 requires lead abatement to be conducted safely and allows qualifying property owners to abate their own dwellings under specified safety and consultation conditions.

headings.title: Compliance inspection entry authority and credentials
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes departmental representatives presenting credentials to enter property for lead contractor compliance inspections

headings.title: Search warrants for refused inspection access
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits refusing inspection access and authorizes issuance of search warrants upon showing of probable cause

headings.title: Notice of violation and corrective action content
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to issue written violation notices specifying reasons, reasonable compliance time, service methods, and required corrective actions.

headings.title: Administrative hearings and appellate review
headings.reviewNote: Provides ten-day hearing request window, thirty-day hearing timeline, and administrative hearing commission appeals

headings.title: Enforcement actions by attorney general or prosecutor
headings.reviewNote: Directs the attorney general or county prosecuting attorney, upon request of a city, county, or the department, to institute appropriate proceedings for correction.

headings.title: Emergency restraining orders and temporary injunctions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes emergency temporary restraining orders and injunctions for imminent health hazard conditions

headings.title: Discretionary written warnings in lieu of notice
headings.reviewNote: Allows department to issue suitable written notices or warnings in lieu of formal notices of violation

headings.title: Publication of departmental enforcement manual
headings.reviewNote: Directs development and website publication of enforcement manual categorizing violations and warning criteria

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.311 sets forth lead abatement compliance inspection powers, search warrant procedures, notices of violation, administrative appeals, injunctions, and enforcement manual publications.

headings.title: Licensing program and rulemaking for lead professionals
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to develop a licensing program and promulgate rules for lead inspectors, risk assessors, lead abatement supervisors, workers, project designers, and contractors.

headings.title: Mandatory liability insurance and indemnification
headings.reviewNote: Requires lead abatement contractors to maintain liability and errors and omissions insurance and proof of indemnification capacity

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.312 authorizes licensing and standards for lead inspectors, supervisors, and contractors, and requires contractors to maintain liability insurance and indemnification proof.

headings.title: Notice required from grant or loan issuing agencies
headings.reviewNote: Requires agencies issuing lead abatement grants or loans to give written notice at least ten days prior to project commencement

headings.title: Fine for failure to provide project notice
headings.reviewNote: Assesses two-hundred-fifty-dollar fine on funding entities failing to provide required project notice

headings.title: Emergency notification procedures for lending agencies
headings.reviewNote: Establishes twenty-four-hour informal notice and five-day written submission timeline for emergency loan or grant projects

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.313 requires entities issuing lead abatement grants or loans to notify the department before project onset, prescribes fines for noncompliance, and establishes emergency exceptions.

headings.title: Mandatory training and licensing for lead activities
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits conducting lead-bearing substance activities without accredited training and departmental licensure

headings.title: Maintenance and publication of licensed personnel lists
headings.reviewNote: Requires department to maintain and distribute free public lists of licensed lead professionals

headings.title: Immediate license disciplinary actions and appeals
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes immediate license restriction, suspension, revocation, or denial subject to administrative hearing commission review

headings.title: Immediate cease-work orders for health risks
headings.reviewNote: Empowers director to issue immediate cease-work orders when license violations present health risks

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.316 prohibits unlicensed lead inspections and abatement, directs publication of licensee lists, and authorizes immediate license suspension and cease-work orders for health risks.

headings.title: Authority to assess administrative penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes administrative penalties following a prior notice of violation for the same violation type within the calendar year, and waives collection if required statutory, collection, or appeal statements are omitted.

headings.title: Rulemaking criteria for penalty assessments
headings.reviewNote: Requires penalty assessment rules considering harm, previous compliance record, and relevant factors

headings.title: Payment schedules, appeals, surcharges, and collection
headings.reviewNote: Establishes sixty-day payment period, ten-day appeal timeline, stays, surcharges, interest, and judicial collection

headings.title: Calculation limits and two-year discovery limitation
headings.reviewNote: Bars penalty increases caused by agency delay and imposes two-year limitation from discovery of violation

headings.title: Judicial review of administrative penalty orders
headings.reviewNote: Provides for judicial review of final administrative penalty orders under section 536.100 in county circuit court

headings.title: Option to pursue civil penalties in court
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to elect civil court action by attorney general or prosecutor in lieu of administrative penalty

headings.title: Deposit of penalties in lead abatement loan fund
headings.reviewNote: Directs deposit of collected penalties into Missouri lead abatement loan fund and disallows charitable tax deductions

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.317 authorizes administrative penalties for lead violations, sets procedural rules and discovery limits, governs appeals and court collections, and directs funds to lead loans.

headings.title: Laboratory analysis regulations and quality assurance
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to promulgate regulations and quality control standards for lead-bearing substance analysis

headings.title: Mandatory federal CLIA compliance for blood lead testing
headings.reviewNote: Requires all laboratories performing blood lead analyses to comply with the federal Clinical Lab Improvement Act (CLIA).

headings.title: Reporting required for blood lead testing results
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that all laboratories report blood lead testing results pursuant to departmental rule

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.318 directs the department to establish laboratory quality assurance regulations, mandates federal CLIA compliance, and requires reporting of blood lead results.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor classifications
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations of specified lead abatement and inspection statutes as class A misdemeanors

headings.title: Class E felony for suspended or revoked practitioners
headings.reviewNote: Designates conducting lead abatement while license is suspended or revoked as a class E felony

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.320 designates general lead safety violations as class A misdemeanors and elevates performing lead abatement while under license suspension or revocation to a class E felony.

headings.title: Lead poisoning information reporting system established
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to establish and maintain reporting system for lead cases to support epidemiologic studies

headings.title: Rulemaking for reporting levels and medical details
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to promulgate rules specifying reportable lead poisoning levels, optional medical/occupational details, filing timelines, and reporting forms.

headings.title: Health care professional reporting obligations
headings.reviewNote: Requires attending health care professionals to submit required patient lead poisoning information

headings.title: Dissemination of case reports to local health agencies
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director to inform local boards of health, public health agencies, and other necessary persons/organizations of reported cases while excluding a child's name unless necessary for the child's health and well-being.

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.326 establishes a lead poisoning reporting system, authorizes reporting rules, requires health care providers to submit patient data, and provides for local health notifications.

headings.title: Confidentiality of patient and physician identities
headings.reviewNote: Protects confidentiality of patients and physicians and restricts release without written consent

headings.title: Interagency disclosure exception for official duties
headings.reviewNote: Allows confidential information disclosure without consent to government employees and agents for official public duties

headings.title: Research publications, geographic indexing, and data sharing
headings.reviewNote: Directs research reporting, geographic indexing of high incidence areas, and data sharing with qualified researchers

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.328 protects patient and provider confidentiality in lead reporting, allows disclosure to public officials performing duties, and authorizes research data sharing and geographic indexing.

headings.title: Immunity for reporting lead information in good faith
headings.reviewNote: Grants civil and criminal immunity for providing lead reporting information unless the individual or organization acted in bad faith, negligently, or with malicious purpose.

headings.title: Protection against compelled medical examination or treatment
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that lead reporting provisions do not compel individuals to submit to medical examinations or treatment

headings.title: Infraction penalty for statutory violations
headings.reviewNote: Classifies violations of sections 701.318 through 701.330 as infractions

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.330 grants civil and criminal immunity for good faith reporting, confirms individuals cannot be compelled to undergo examination or treatment, and designates violations as infractions.

headings.title: Federal cooperation and childhood lead educational clearinghouse
headings.reviewNote: Directs cooperation with the federal government under 15 U.S.C. 2685(d)-(e) for public education and an information clearinghouse, and authorizes additional department educational materials.

headings.title: Interagency strategy for Medicaid lead testing
headings.reviewNote: Requires collaborative strategy among health and social services agencies to increase lead testing under Medicaid

headings.title: Children's division outreach regarding screening and treatment
headings.reviewNote: Directs children's division to inform clients of lead screening and treatment through EPSDT Medicaid services

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.336 requires federal cooperation on childhood lead education, directs an interagency strategy to expand Medicaid lead screening, and mandates social services client outreach.

headings.title: Financial assistance program for lead abatement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department plan for lead abatement loans and grants in consultation with natural resources and economic development

headings.title: Program applications from local public and nonprofit entities
headings.reviewNote: Directs program to accept project applications from municipalities, counties, and local non-profit community organizations

headings.title: Missouri lead abatement loan fund created
headings.reviewNote: Establishes non-reverting lead abatement loan fund in state treasury funded by penalties, appropriations, and repayments

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.337 authorizes loan and grant programs for property lead abatement, accepts applications from local entities, and creates the dedicated Missouri lead abatement loan fund.

headings.title: Annual parental education and lead testing offerings
headings.reviewNote: Directs DHSS (subject to appropriations) to implement a childhood lead testing program and requires medical providers and health care facilities serving children under age four to provide annual education and offer testing with parental consent.

headings.title: Blood sample protocol and laboratory licensing
headings.reviewNote: Requires blood samples analyzed by CLIA-licensed laboratories under departmental testing protocol rules

headings.title: Exemption based on parental or guardian objection
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that children may not be required to undergo lead testing over parental or guardian objection

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.340 establishes a childhood lead testing program requiring providers to educate parents and offer annual blood tests, specifying laboratory standards and honoring parental objections.

headings.title: Identification of geographic high-risk lead areas
headings.reviewNote: Requires department to identify geographic areas at high risk for lead poisoning using testing data and indices

headings.title: Annual risk assessment questionnaire for young children
headings.reviewNote: Mandates annual CDC-aligned risk assessment questionnaires for children under age six developed with social services, while authorizing DHSS to broaden high-risk scope and local health boards to add questions.

headings.title: Mandatory blood testing for children deemed high risk
headings.reviewNote: Requires blood testing with parental consent for any child identified as high risk by the assessment questionnaire

headings.title: Laboratory reporting and follow-up testing protocols
headings.reviewNote: Mandates laboratory reporting and follow-up testing and treatment protocols for children testing positive

headings.title: Household contact testing upon reported lead cases
headings.reviewNote: Directs testing of household contacts under age six and other at-risk persons upon notification of a lead poisoning case

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.342 directs geographic risk identification, annual questionnaire assessments, mandatory blood testing for high-risk children, laboratory reporting, and household contact testing.

headings.title: Lead testing documentation for high-risk childcare facilities
headings.reviewNote: Requires high-risk area child care facilities, within thirty days of enrolling a child aged 12 months to under five years (and annually thereafter), to obtain lead testing proof or written parental refusal, provide testing info, and optionally arrange local health officer testing with consent.

headings.title: Prohibition against denying education or child care access
headings.reviewNote: Bars denying access to education or child care based on failure to comply with lead testing statutes

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.344 requires childcare facilities in high-risk areas to request lead test documentation or written refusals, while prohibiting denial of educational or childcare access.

headings.title: Childhood lead testing fund created and permitted uses
headings.reviewNote: Creates childhood lead testing fund in state treasury to support program administration, blood tests for uninsured children, and education

headings.title: Nonreversion of fund moneys to general revenue
headings.reviewNote: Exempts moneys in childhood lead testing fund from biennial transfer to general revenue under section 33.080

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.345 establishes the childhood lead testing fund, specifies permitted expenditures for screening and education, and exempts fund balances from biennial lapse to general revenue.

headings.title: Composition, appointment, and party affiliation of board
headings.reviewNote: Establishes eleven-member elevator safety board, five-year terms, vacancy procedures, and political party limits

headings.title: Industry, professional, and public stakeholder representation
headings.reviewNote: Specifies board representation from elevator labor, manufacturers, an architect or mechanical engineer, building owners, building officials, the disabled community, and special inspectors.

headings.title: Board meetings, chairman election, and quorum requirements
headings.reviewNote: Directs initial meeting, chairman election, quarterly meeting schedule, and six-member quorum requirement

headings.title: Compensation restriction and per diem expense reimbursement
headings.reviewNote: Provides that members serve without salary but receive per diem expense allowances equivalent to general assembly members

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.353 creates the eleven-member elevator safety board, details member qualifications and terms, and establishes operational rules, quorum thresholds, and expense allowances.

headings.title: Annual inspection duties and statutory exemptions
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual inspection of new and existing installations, excluding material lifts and single-family residences, and exempts installations used in mining, tunneling, milling, smelting, refining, and ore beneficiation.

headings.title: Compliance orders and emergency discontinuance of dangerous installations
headings.reviewNote: Directs the chief inspector to issue compliance orders for violations and order discontinuance of unsafe or dangerous installations until remedied, served personally or by mail.

headings.title: Authority of authorized special inspectors
headings.reviewNote: Permits special inspectors to conduct inspections when authorized by the board or a political subdivision

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.365 mandates annual elevator inspections, excepts single-family homes and mining operations, authorizes compliance and out-of-service orders, and permits special inspectors.

headings.title: Local enforcement authority under qualifying inspection ordinances
headings.reviewNote: Vests state inspector powers in political subdivisions enacting qualifying local annual elevator inspection laws

headings.title: Statutory exemption for compliant materials handling equipment
headings.reviewNote: Exempts materials handling equipment complying with ANSI B20.1 standards from elevator safety statutes

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.367 grants inspector enforcement powers to political subdivisions enacting qualifying annual inspection laws and exempts materials handling equipment meeting national standards.

headings.title: Inspector certification and professional qualification requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires board certification for safety inspectors based on education and four years of technical experience, including elevator work

headings.title: Professional code adoption and certificate revocation
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board to establish a professional code for covered inspectors and authorizes certification revocation after notice and hearing.

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.369 requires elevator safety inspectors to obtain board certification based on defined technical experience, authorizes a professional code, and provides for certificate revocation.

headings.title: Construction and alteration permits required
headings.reviewNote: Requires board-issued permit before beginning construction or major alteration of private or state installations

headings.title: Plan submission and compliance demonstrations
headings.reviewNote: Mandates submission of plans and information demonstrating compliance with elevator safety code prior to construction

headings.title: Operating permits and temporary operation allowances
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits operation without permit, establishes issuance conditions, and authorizes renewable sixty-day temporary operation permits

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.373 requires board permits prior to elevator construction or major alteration, plan review for code compliance, and operating permits, allowing temporary sixty-day authorizations.

headings.title: Operating certificate issuance and required information
headings.reviewNote: Directs board to issue operating certificate specifying rated load, speed, inspection dates, and inspector signature spaces

headings.title: Posting locations for operating certificates
headings.reviewNote: Mandates posting operating permits in noncombustible frames in elevator machine rooms or as directed by the board

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.375 prescribes operating certificate issuance, specifies load and inspection data requirements, and mandates visible posting in elevator machine rooms or designated areas.

headings.title: Administrative appeals from state safety inspectors
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appeal of state inspector decisions to the chief safety inspector, with appeals of chief safety inspector decisions taken as provided in chapter 536.

headings.title: Municipal appeals under local ordinances
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes persons aggrieved by municipal inspector decisions to appeal under applicable municipal ordinances

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.379 establishes appeal paths for aggrieved persons challenging state elevator inspection decisions under chapter 536 and local decisions under municipal ordinances.

headings.title: Definition of crime of abuse of elevator safety
headings.reviewNote: Defines the crime of abuse of elevator safety as willful violation of sections 701.350 to 701.380 or operating an installation ordered out of service.

headings.title: Classification as class C misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Classifies the crime of abuse of elevator safety as a class C misdemeanor

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.380 defines the crime of abuse of elevator safety for willful violations or unauthorized operation and classifies the offense as a class C misdemeanor.

headings.title: Equal fixture ratios for public amusement facilities
headings.reviewNote: Requires public amusement facilities with construction commencing after August 28, 1995, to provide equal water closets for women as water closets and urinals for men, and equal diaper changing stations for men as for women.

headings.title: Renovation standards for existing facilities
headings.reviewNote: Applies equal restroom fixture ratios to pre-existing public amusement facilities undergoing major structural renovation

headings.title: Definition of major structural renovation
headings.reviewNote: Defines major structural renovation as rebuilding over fifty percent of floor area and limits scope to renovated areas

headings.title: Compliance extension in cities not within a county
headings.reviewNote: Provides a one-year compliance extension from substantial completion for qualifying facilities in cities not within a county

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.450 requires places of public amusement to provide equal water closets and diaper changing stations, applies requirements to major renovations, and provides a local extension.

headings.title: Definitions for appliance energy efficiency standards
headings.reviewNote: Defines department, director, and Energy Star program for appliance energy efficiency standards

headings.title: Scope of application to non-federally regulated appliances
headings.reviewNote: Applies efficiency standards to appliances lacking federal minimum energy efficiency standards

headings.title: Sales and installation prohibition for noncompliant products
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits selling, offering for sale, or installing covered new products that do not meet state efficiency standards

headings.title: Excluded products and non-retail transactions
headings.reviewNote: Exempts consumer electronics, out-of-state sales, mobile manufactured home factory installations, and recreational vehicles

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.500 defines appliance energy terms, applies efficiency standards to products lacking federal regulation, bans noncompliant sales, and establishes statutory exemptions.

headings.title: Promulgation of minimum appliance energy efficiency standards
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director, with the advisory group, to promulgate minimum efficiency rules subject to chapter 536 compliance and post-August 28, 2008 nonseverability.

headings.title: Ceiling alignment with federal Energy Star requirements
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits state appliance efficiency standards from being more stringent than federal Energy Star program requirements, if applicable.

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.503 grants rulemaking authority for appliance efficiency standards subject to nonseverability provisions and prohibits standards more stringent than federal Energy Star requirements.

headings.title: Creation, purpose, and composition of advisory group
headings.reviewNote: Creates eleven-member appliance energy efficiency advisory group representing utilities, industry, public counsel, and technical experts

headings.title: Member terms, expense reimbursement, and semiannual meetings
headings.reviewNote: Establishes three-year terms with reappointment allowed, uncompensated service with permissive expense reimbursement, departmental staffing, and at least two meetings per year.

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.509 establishes the appliance energy efficiency advisory group, defines its multi-stakeholder composition, sets three-year terms, and directs at least two meetings annually.

headings.title: Product testing procedures and approved testing methods
headings.reviewNote: Directs adoption of DOE-approved or national test methods and requires manufacturers to test sample products

headings.title: Manufacturer certification of efficiency compliance
headings.reviewNote: Requires manufacturer compliance certification, directs the director to promulgate certification regulations, and authorizes coordination with other states' certification programs.

headings.title: Product and package labeling and marking requirements
headings.reviewNote: Mandates compliant product markings and package labels coordinated with other state and federal labeling programs

headings.title: State product testing, cost assessment, and public disclosure
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director testing of covered products and requires charging purchase/testing costs to noncompliant manufacturers and making noncompliance information public.

headings.title: Periodic distributor and retailer compliance inspections
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to conduct periodic inspections of product distributors and retailers to verify compliance

headings.title: Implementation and enforcement rulemaking authority
headings.reviewNote: Grants the director authority to adopt implementation and enforcement regulations subject to chapter 536 compliance and post-August 28, 2008 nonseverability.

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.512 details appliance efficiency testing procedures, manufacturer certification and labeling duties, state testing and inspection powers, and administrative rulemaking authority.

headings.title: Definitions regarding anemometer towers
headings.reviewNote: Defines anemometer, anemometer tower, and area surrounding anchor point

headings.title: Visibility, marking, and safety sleeve requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires aviation orange/white painting, guy-wire marker balls, contrasting anchor areas (fenced if grazed), and seven-foot safety sleeves for rural towers fifty feet or higher (by January 1, 2014 if erected before August 28, 2012; upon erection thereafter).

headings.title: Classification as class B misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Designates violation of anemometer tower marking standards as a class B misdemeanor

entries.reviewSummary: Section 701.550 defines anemometer towers, establishes mandatory painting, marker ball, and safety sleeve standards for rural towers fifty feet or higher, and designates violations as class B misdemeanors.
